svg.aria-label: Two triangles as they land on the monitor. On the left the corners 0, 1, 2 turn counter-clockwise, a front with COUNTER_CLOCKWISE. On the right 1 and 2 are swapped, so 0, 1, 2 turn clockwise, a front with CLOCKWISE.
svg.title: Two triangles as they land on the monitor. On the left the corners 0, 1, 2 turn counter-clockwise, a front with COUNTER_CLOCKWISE. On the right 1 and 2 are swapped, so 0, 1, 2 turn clockwise, a front with CLOCKWISE.
